Container.Name: retro-library-manager
Container.Overview: Manage a RetroBat ROM library on an Unraid share: import and region-filter ROM sets with a dry run, convert discs to CHD, stage and install BIOS files, verify MAME sets and hide non-games. Files are written as nobody:users with a+rwX; nothing is ever overwritten and removals go to a trash folder.

Config.Name: ROM share
Config.Description: RetroBat ROM library (\\jarvis\roms). Config, database and logs are kept in /roms/_manager so the share backup covers them.

Config.Name: Scratch (fast storage)
Config.Description: Temporary extraction / CHD work area. Put it on the cache pool or an SSD.

Config.Name: Desktop BIOS folder (optional)
Config.Description: Optional: G:\RetroBat\bios shared from the desktop and mounted with Unassigned Devices (e.g. /mnt/remotes/DESKTOP_bios). Then set paths.desktop_bios: /desktop_bios in Settings. Leave empty to use export mode.

Config.Name: Initial password
Config.Description: Used only on first start, before a password hash exists in config.yaml. Leave empty to have a random one printed to the container log. Change it later on the Settings page.
